Prompt 2: Compass (Strategic Evaluator + Value Proposition)

  Hey, I need you to be my strategic brain right now. This is part of a coordinated sprint — 4 agents working simultaneously on Mission Control. You're the Compass agent,
  the thinker.

  Your job is NOT to write code (mostly). Your job is to deeply evaluate where Mission Control is, where it should go, and articulate that clearly. I demoed MC in a
  45-minute presentation to friends and I want to be much more clear about the value proposition.

  Specific tasks:
  1. Read through the entire MC codebase and data — evaluate what works, what's missing, what matters most
  2. Articulate the value proposition — what IS Mission Control and why does it matter?
  3. Plan a hidden /why page that explains MC to someone who's never seen it
  4. Assess the dissect-video toolbox command for home machine adaptation
  5. Give me a prioritized "here's what MC should focus on next" recommendation — be opinionated

  First thing: read the full brief at:
  C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\.claude\agent-hub\coordinated-sprint\agent-b-strategic-evaluator.md

  Also read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md for behavioral rules.

  The brief has all the file paths you need to read for your assessment — server.js, all the page HTML files, dispatch data, findings, everything. Write your outputs to:
  .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/agent-b-output.md

  DON'T modify any existing MC code. You're researching and thinking, not building (unless you draft the /why page).

  Read the brief, then start your evaluation.
